en:
I've heard the stories about idol auditions that
just scam girls into walking into terrible things...

It'll be too late if she gets inside.
I better go after Hikaru.
There! It's Hikaru and that guy.

We'll be right inside here, sweetheart.
After you.

Great. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Is this the office where everyone works?

I-I'm not sure...!
I don't think anyone's in today...

Huh? But didn't you say I'd be meeting
everyone for the first time today?

Ah, details!
Let's just go inside, shall we!?

This guy's as shady as they come.
Hikaru's definitely in danger here.

Why have you been tailing us?
Something you wanna say?

All of you...
What are your plans for Hikaru?

Hikaru?
We don't have to tell you shit, man.

You one of those stalkers or something?
Either way, you're gonna be real sorry...

You're interfering with business now...
Let's show this dumbass the door!
Tch... He's a monster...
Sorry, but I'm going in now.
...A gunshot!?
Hikaru!!
Kiryu-san!?
This... What's going on...?
Kiryu-san, thanks for waiting.

Sorry about that. I had no idea they
would throw you a surprise party...

They got me good, too! But don't worry,
the president laughed it off and forgave you.

In fact, I think they're trying to
recruit you as a bodyguard.
I feel terrible about it...

To be honest... I had my doubts about the
legitimacy of this production company too...

I've heard a lot of terrible things about
suspicious production companies...

But thanks to all this,
I'm sure I can trust everyone here!

Knowing I'm in the hands of a good company...
It makes me want to really work hard for them.
Yeah, that's great.

But... what really made me happy...
was that you were worried about me, Kiryu-san.

That you risked yourself to protect me...
It made me feel so appreciated.
All I did was run in circles...

But if you ever find yourself in trouble again,
I'll be there to help, no matter what.

So you keep chasing your dream
without any fear, Hikaru.

Um... Kiryu-san...
Would you mind if I gave you a present?
Oh! Kiryu-san!

Did I keep you waiting long?
Well, ready to go?
Totally. <symbol=note_with_outline>

The view's great here...
So, what did you need to tell me?

Um... Well... I know we've already
talked so much, Kiryu-san...

I feel like I've talked so much about myself though,
and you've never had the chance to reciprocate...

Hmm. Well, now that you mention it,
maybe it's been a little one-sided.

That's why...
I have several questions for you, Kiryu-san.

No problem.
So... what do you want to know?

Huh? W-Well... 
How about, um... the type of women you like?

My type...?
W-Well...

I like a woman who's pure
and ladylike, I suppose.

I see... So kinda like the
traditional Japanese woman, then?

Yeah. You may be from Taiwan...
But you're very much my type, Sora.
M-Me? I'm ladylike?

I don't know about that... but you're refined.
And you care a lot about your family.

Thank you so much...
I love getting compliments from you...

I like a woman who's pure
and energetic.

I see... So someone who can kind of
balance out your more reserved style?

Yeah.
In a sense, you're my type, Sora.

M-Me?
I'm energetic?

Yeah. You make the most out of living in
a country you hardly know, and that's great.
On top of that, you're honest and pure.
Is there anything else you wanted to ask?

Yes... Um...
Something else...
Whew... The wind's getting chilly.
Yeah, I can't believe it's already winter.

So true. We probably better head home
before we catch cold...

...What's wrong?
Are you ready to go?

Um... Kiryu-san...
Is it okay if I ask one last question?

Um... Kiryu-san, I feel like you're a
man who's already set on his path.

But... I can't help but wonder if you're
the type to ever settle down with a woman.
Hm... Marriage...

It might be nice to get married someday, but
I don't have the luxury of thinking about it now.
I have something I have to finish first...
Something to finish?

I can't say much, but...
like you, I have family I truly care about.

Family... Kiryu-san, are you saying
you were married before?

No, but she may as well be my family.
There's this girl I consider my daughter.

She got into an accident recently... and on
top of everything else, she hasn't woken up...

I'm sorry, I didn't know you were dealing with something
so horrible, and here I am talking about marriage...
What a joke of a hostess I am...

That's not true at all.
In fact, talking to you has given me courage.
...Courage?

Yeah. When I heard how much you cared for your
family... It only strengthened my resolve.

For her... For my whole family...
I have to be ready to put my life on the line.

Protecting your family, making a life for your family,
risking your life for your family...

I realized how important these seemingly
ordinary things are from talking to you.
Thanks... Sora.
...No, I should be thanking you, Kiryu-san.

I hope that whatever you need to accomplish...
ends up being a spectacular success, Kiryu-san.

By the way, there was something else you
wanted to ask, wasn't there?

No, it's fine.
I don't need to ask it anymore.
Mhm. I'm glad you're so dense, Kiryu-san.

But in return...
Can I have just a little more of your time?
Erina told me to wait right around here.
Yo, you were pretty quick.

I was so excited to meet up with you that
I cut out a little early. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Hey, you sure that's going to be okay?

It's no prob. Come on, let's go. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I know exactly which restaurant I want.

Alright then.
...Hm?
Hm? What's the matter?

...No, it was nothing.
Let's get going.
Yep! <symbol=note_with_outline>

I can't shake the feeling that
we're being watched...

It's so nice to be out with you, Kiryu-san.
What should I order?
It's on me, so get anything you want.
I'm not the type of guy to go back on my word.

Thank you! Then I'll take you up on your offer...
Excuse me!

Um, I'll have this, an order of this and that...
One of these... An order of that, too...

This one, this one... And an extra one of these! This on the side... 
and definitely the one that put them on the map!
What a feast!

Ahhh, everything was so delicious! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Thank you for the meal, Kiryu-san!
U-Uh... You really can scarf it down...

Yeah, I wasn't lying when I said I ate big...
Oh, that restaurant looks pretty good too...
Y-You're still hungry?

I don't stay full very long, I guess...
Kind of explains why I don't eat out, doesn't it?
You've got it bad...

Kiryu-san?
Is something wrong?
I figured as much. We're being followed.
What!? Followed!?

Hey, you. You've been stalking us for a while,
haven't you?
W-Who are you to accuse me of that!?

I-I-I was just keeping an eye on you to make sure
you didn't do anything to hurt Erina-chan!
Huh? What are you talking about?

Poor, sweet Erina-chan... Getting forced to
hang out with this big yakuza lug...
Ah, you're...!
You know this guy?

Of course she does! We're an item!
W-W-We're in love...!

W-We aren't an "item," and we're certainly not
in love!
We only met once at a school club!
No need to be so shy about us, Erina-chan.

You were so sweet to me...
I know you really like me, right?
N-No... You've got the wrong idea...

Besides, how can you say we've only met once?
I watch over you every day, Erina-chan.
What? Every day?

Looks like we solved your stalker problem...
This must be our guy.

Why don't you ditch this thug and come have
fun with me, Erina-chan?

That's enough.
You're making a fool of yourself.

Shut up! Who do you think are, talking to me like
that!? And how dare you act so close to Erina-chan!?
You... Just who are you to Erina-chan!?
Erina is...
...my girl.

That's why...
I'm not letting you anywhere near her.

Excuse me!?
I'm Erina's real boyfriend, asshole!
Ahh!
Anyone who gets in my way... has to die!
Agh... Son of a...

Don't ever speak another word to Erina again.
If you even come near her, you'll regret it.

I can't go out with you, and there's no need for
you to watch over me, okay?
I... already have someone special...
D... Dammit...! You asshooooole!

Thank you so much...
...I've caused a lot of trouble for you.
Don't worry about it.

...Maybe I'm just bad at this romance thing.
It never seems to work out in my favor.

People I'm not even pursuing get the wrong idea,
and other people I like think I'm too fake...
You've had a rough go of it.

It was enough to make me want to give up
on romance for a while.

But lately, I've been thinking I need to keep
putting myself out there...
Yeah?

But I was really surprised back there...
When... When you called me your girl.
Oh, sorry about that.

I figured if I lied to him like that,
it might make him back down.

N-No, I was just surprised.
It actually made me happy.

And then... I thought maybe it wouldn't
have to stay a lie...
N-Nothing!

But... considering your track record Erina,
there may be other guys who get the wrong idea, too.

I think I've figured out that I'm being too nice,
all because I want to be liked in return.

But all I've accomplished by doing that is hurting
other people and sabotaging my own chances...

So from now on,
I'm going to be honest with myself.

Worrying about how people think of me, or whether
or not they like me... I'm done being tied down by that.

Hm... Sounds like you've finally figured it out.
Does that mean we can say goodbye to fake Erina?

Yep, from today on, no more fake Erina.
I won't put on a show of being so sweet anymore.

But, to balance that out...
maybe I'll be more assertive with people I like?
Ah, Kiryu-san.

Did I keep you waiting?
Sorry about that.

Not at all, I just got here myself.
Shall we, then?

It's all thanks to your sweet talk that
I have these debts now! Own up to it!

H-How is that my fault!?
You're the one who ordered it all, aren't you!?

You said you wouldn't have a good time
unless I ordered champagne and all that...

And after I order half the menu, you go and
get me banned from the club!? You bitch!
No! S-Someone help!

The guy's trying to pin his debts on that
hostess. A sorry and familiar tune...
Huh? I think she's from our club...
Hey, wait.
What do you think you're doing?
R-Riona-san...!

This is exactly why I always tell you not to
put so much pressure on your customers.

I'm sorry...
I never imagined he'd do this...
Hey, who the hell are you!?

I sincerely apologize if you felt any pressure
to spend money at our club.

But, in the end, the choice rests with the customer,
and we can't assume responsibility for that.

What is this shit?
You think I'm gonna let a woman lecture me!?
Fuck it, I ain't above punching you out!
Gah!
Kiryu-san...?

Listen, I'm not letting you hit her or anyone else
I'm with. See how far you get with me, first.
Asshole... I'll destroy you!
I-I'm so sorry!
There's nothin' to apologize for.

But... You're right, if I'd followed your advice,
this never would have happened.

When I saw the way you never pressured clients
into buying, I thought you were just a weakling...
In the hostess business, sales are everything...

But I see just how wrong I was, now.
Your customers would never sink this low.

Everyone admires you, Riona-san,
and they always leave the club so happy...

I... want to be just like you.
I don't want to cause any more sadness.

I'm sure you can pull it off.
And I've got your back, all the way.

Thank you! From here on, I'm going to be a
more conscientious hostess! Thank you so much!

Good for you. Looks like you've got another
junior hostess who's willing to listen.
Yep. Kiryu-san, thank you.

No prob. But y'know, you should have let me handle
that. It's a man's job to protect the woman he's with.

You're right, sorry...
I just wanted to rescue that poor girl...

I understand what you mean, and I like that about
you. But you've got to lean on others sometimes.

It's not weakness to depend on others.
In fact, it's proof of your strength.
You really are the coolest, Kiryu-san.

Well, what do you say we start over?
You had somewhere you wanted to go?
Yeah, let's go, Kiryu-san.

Hello, sir.
You have quite a knack for this.

I'm the general manager of this
batting center. The name's Yoshida.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>You're</font_kind> Yoshida?

Yes, sir. My father was the original manager,
but I've taken over in his stead recently.

By the way, I must thank you for such
fervent devotion to our challenge courses.

So, how are they? We take great pride
in the challenges we offer here.
